name: Figura Compatibility
description: Numbered Figura hooks remain supported for existing avatars. Indomitable uses figura_1. Mortal Resolve uses the dedicated semantic resource and does not consume another numbered hook. New avatars should use the semantic helper documented in FIGURA_COMPAT.md.
